scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it recently and wanted to see where things stand.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-00473, has been approved and originated.

dialogue.user: That's great news! Can you tell me about the terms of the loan? Specifically, what is my interest rate and what are the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.625%, and the total loan costs are $1481.55.

dialogue.user: Okay, thank you. That's a bit higher than I was expecting. Can you tell me what my loan term is?
360 months... I see. And has this loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was sold to Freddie Mac.

dialogue.user: <Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the information you've provided. It's good to know the status, interest rate, total costs, loan term, and that the loan has been sold. Thank you.
